title: oxalis nipponica subsp. kantoensis
intro: Oxalis nipponica subsp. kantoensis, commonly known as Japanese wood-sorrel or Kanto wood-sorrel, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the wood sorrel family (Oxalidaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis nipponica subsp. kantoensis include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and potential anti-cancer agent, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include oxalic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
